summary: This is a pre-commit configuration file that sets up automated code checks to run before each git commit. It installs two tools: pre-commit-hooks (which does basic file validation) and Black (a code formatter), along with specific checks like validating YAML syntax and removing trailing whitespace.

explanations.3: The 'rev' specifies which version of the pre-commit-hooks repository to use, like pinning a dependency to a specific release.
explanations.9: This is the version of the Black formatter tool being used; newer versions might have different formatting rules, so pinning it ensures consistent behavior across your team.
explanations.11: The 'id: black' activates the Black formatter as one of the checks that will automatically run before you commit code.
